title: Signal: SQL Server client exception text disclosed in a response

check.valuePattern: (?:System\.Data\.SqlClient\.SqlException|Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server|SqlException: (?:Incorrect syntax|Invalid object name|Incorrect column name))

scope: One response body containing a SqlClient or OLE DB SQL Server exception string.
limitations: One response body. The check reads the message text; it does not evaluate whether the connection string is reachable from the scanning host.

observation.body: System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException: A network-related or instance-specific error occurred
Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server error '80040e14'

fpNotes: A documentation page that quotes the exception is reported; an API returning a problem+json detail without SQL text is not.
